paragraphs.text: A Rider–Waite–Smith tarot system for DeepSeek Harness
# DSH Plugin for Rider-Waite-Smith Tarot
[](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=Firefox2100_dsh-rws-tarot) [](https://sonarcloud.io/sum
mary/new_code?id=Firefox2100_dsh-rws-tarot) [](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=Firefox2100
d=Firefox2100_dsh-rws-tarot) [](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=Firefox2100_dsh-rws-tarot)
English | 中文
Rider-Waite-Smith tarot for DeepSeek Harness: lay a spread in the right dock, turn the cards one at
a time and have each read from Arthur Edward Waite's *The Pictorial Key to the Tarot* (1910, public
domain). Code draws the cards and supplies the book's meanings and methods; the language model only
reasons on top of those facts.
For entertainment, study and reflection only. It cannot predict or interpret real events and is no g
uide for decisions; see the disclaimer.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3` and a model the profile can already use. Features, u
sage, configuration and the `/tarot` command are in the plugin README.
## Repository
| Path | Contents |

| `packages/tarot` | The plugin (host and client). |
| `packages/tarot-data` | The book's card, meth

od and recurrence data and the card names. |
| `packages/tarot-engine` | The deterministic engine: s

huffle, layouts, facts for the model. |
| `references/pictorial-key` | The book: text by part, the 7

8 plates, and the page-scan PDF the data is checked against. |
| `scripts` | Data generators and che

the page-scan PDF the data is checked against. |
| `scripts` | Data generators and check scripts. |
The two libraries are bundled into the plugin.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Card data is generated from the book (`node scripts/build-cards.mjs`, `node scripts/build-recurrence
.mjs`); the check scripts fail when the data and the book disagree. More in the plugin README.
